Hi Ben,

Thanks for the invite — our team was able to add the event to Outlook, but the calendar entry shows "No meeting link available" and the body has no conference URL. It looks like the event was forwarded through our internal assistant and Outlook removed the conferencing metadata (we see an empty conference-line where a Meet/Zoom link should be).

Can you resend the invite or just drop the direct meeting URL in an email so we can attach it to the event? We want to avoid everyone joining the wrong meeting room.

Short background: we use Exchange 2019 + an internal automation that proxies forwarded invites; the automation strips attributes it doesn't recognize.

Thanks — Alicia

Hi Alicia — sorry about that, and thanks for the context.

We see this occasionally when external forwards or calendar proxies rewrite the ORGANIZER/CONFERENCE properties. Two quick options:

1) I'll resend the event as the organizer (so our attendee list is authoritative) — that should preserve the conferencing block.
2) We'll send a calendar-free email that contains the Zoom join URL and a shortlink; you can paste that into your Outlook event manually if your automation strips the ICS data.

Marissa — can you regenerate the event from my account, mark me as the organizer, and attach an ICS named "ics-event-v2.ics"? If needed, include the plain text Zoom link in the body and a shortlink to the meeting brief. Also copy the raw Zoom URL into the email itself so Exchange's proxy doesn't get a chance to remove it.

Alicia — I can do option 1 now and option 2 as a backup. Which do you prefer?

Ben
